name: Attend Esports Expo
description: Visit an esports expo and network with industry professionals.

name: Attend Employer Visit
description: Ask prepared questions, observe workflows and note one thing you learned.
flavor: You're not a tourist. You're scouting your future.

name: Check Player Wellbeing
description: Check in on rest, workload and mood before a big event.

name: Coordinate Partner Stream
description: Coordinate a co-stream event with a partner content creator.

name: Create Promo Content
description: Create social media and promotional content for an event or product.

name: Create Tournament Promo
description: Spend focused time producing a poster, short video, social post, or stream overlay.
flavor: Making the thing is always the hardest part.

name: Judge Community Tournament
description: Judge matches in a community tournament and provide feedback.

name: Manage Player Roster
description: Handle player contracts, substitutions, and team composition.

name: Negotiate Sponsorship Deal
description: Negotiate a sponsorship deal with a brand partner.

name: Operate the Live Stream
description: Run camera, graphics or audio during a live broadcast.
flavor: The stream is the show — and the show must go on.

name: Plan a Practice Session
description: Design a practice block with clear goals for a squad or player.
flavor: A plan turns practice into progress.

name: Publish Event Coverage
description: Write up or photograph an event for publication.
flavor: If it isn't published, it didn't happen — as far as the internet's concerned.

name: Review Match VODs
description: Watch back recent matches and note patterns worth acting on.

name: Run a Community Session
description: Host a Q&A, watch party or community event for fans or players.
flavor: Communities grow around people who show up.

name: Run Training Session
description: Run a training session for aspiring players.

name: Set Up Match Day
description: Prepare kit, seating, signage and schedules ahead of a live event.
flavor: Match day starts hours before the first game.

name: Track Player Metrics
description: Log stats across sessions to spot trends in performance.
flavor: If you can't measure it, you're guessing.

name: Volunteer at Tournament
description: Choose a role — registration, player support, setup, social posts, or match scheduling — and get stuck in.
flavor: Tournaments run on volunteers like you.

name: Help Team Rank Up
description: Your coaching strategies significantly improve team performance.

name: Achieve Sponsor Goals
description: Successfully execute partnership deliverables that meet sponsor KPIs.

name: Collect Event Feedback
description: Gather feedback from attendees about the tournament or event.

name: Post-Match Team Meeting
description: Lead a post-match analysis session with the team.

name: Book Studio Visit
description: Confirm the visit date, location, booking, and travel or access arrangements. Prepare two questions.
flavor: Turning up unprepared wastes everyone's time.

name: Book the Visit
description: Confirm your place, location, joining details and any security requirements.
flavor: A booked visit is a foot in the door.

name: Confirm Volunteer Shift
description: Confirm the organiser, event date, location, responsibilities, start/finish times and who supervises you.
flavor: A shift no one confirmed is a shift that falls through.

name: Find a Volunteer Shift
description: Choose an event with a clear role, organiser and genuine need for help.
flavor: The best volunteers show up where they're needed most.

name: Confirm Placement Details
description: Agree tasks, dates, days and hours with the employer; collect their contact details and address; confirm your tutor's name.
flavor: No request goes anywhere without the details.

name: Complete Placement Onboarding
description: Submit required paperwork, set up your workspace access, and confirm your reporting line with your supervisor.
flavor: Paperwork is boring. Getting started is not.

name: Research Industry Standards
description: Study current best practices, pipelines, and quality bars for your discipline.
flavor: Know the bar before you raise it.

name: Create Personal Learning Plan
description: Map skills to acquire, resources to use, and milestones to hit during the experience.
flavor: A plan turns hope into progress.

name: Set Up Portfolio Tracking
description: Create a system to capture work-in-progress, feedback, and final pieces for your portfolio.
flavor: Document as you go, not after.

name: Establish Communication Routines
description: Agree on check-in frequency, update formats, and escalation paths with your supervisor.
flavor: Communication is a skill, not an afterthought.

name: Define Success Metrics
description: Agree on what "done well" looks like: quality, speed, innovation, or player impact.
flavor: You can't hit a target you can't see.

name: Prepare Questions for Mentor
description: List specific technical, creative, and career questions to maximize mentor sessions.

name: Prototype a Core System
description: Build a quick proof-of-concept for a key mechanic, tool, or pipeline.

name: Collaborate Cross-Discipline
description: Work with a different discipline (art/code/design) to integrate a feature end-to-end.
flavor: Great games are built at discipline boundaries.

name: Optimize a Workflow
description: Identify a bottleneck and implement a faster process, script, or template.

name: Run a Playtest Session
description: Observe players, take notes, and identify friction points in the experience.

name: Create Technical Documentation
description: Write clear docs for a system, API, or pipeline so others can use and maintain it.
flavor: Documentation is empathy for your future self.

name: Refactor for Maintainability
description: Clean up messy code, rigs, or files to improve readability and reduce future bugs.

name: Record Peer Feedback
description: Document specific feedback from teammates and how you acted on it.

name: Capture Before/After Comparison
description: Show side-by-side evidence of improvement: performance, quality, or player experience.

name: Write a Case Study Outline
description: Structure a portfolio case study: problem, process, solution, result, reflection.

name: Collect Quantitative Metrics
description: Gather data: frame rates, load times, player retention, iteration speed, bug counts.

name: Document a Failure & Recovery
description: Record what went wrong, root cause analysis, and the fix that prevented recurrence.

name: Create a Showcase Video/GIF
description: Record a 30-second clip of your work in context: in-engine, in-game, or in-pipeline.

name: Feature Adopted by Team
description: Your prototype, tool, or process was adopted as standard practice by the team.

name: Mentored a Peer
description: Helped another student/junior improve their skills through guidance and knowledge sharing.

name: Contributed to Shipped Content
description: Your work is part of content that reached players, even in a small way.
flavor: Shipped is the only metric that counts.

name: Wild Card: Industry Veteran Insight
description: A veteran shares hard-won wisdom. Use in place of any Setup, Action, or Proof card for any set.

name: Wild Card: Cross-Discipline Workshop
description: An intensive workshop bridges disciplines. Use in place of any card for any set.

name: Wild Card: Personal Project Sprint
description: A focused personal project fills a gap. Use in place of any card for any set.
